limits: Uniform legal paths are diagnostic weighting, not human route choice.
Fixed formation cohort is not a granted collection; acquired copies not selected.
No new economic rule implemented. Bean basket is opportunity cost only and does not claim item benefit.

Sessions and action durations are explicit unmeasured assumptions; resourceElapsed is a lower bound; daily schedules include cap and energy waits during the visit. Mobile/desktop automation is not human timing.
First claims keyed by 4 duel level IDs and 1 boss; paid vault once only. No repeat keys.
Encounters passed; actual new trades can alter survival but not produce currency.
No finite opening count guarantees full collection.
